summary: Report startup phase durations once when both daemon listeners are ready.

replay.detail: Replication replay behavior is unchanged; projection chunks do not emit additional timing summaries.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or data changes. The structured startup log contains numeric millisecond durations for initialization phases and their total.

rules.detail: No authorization, judging, or settlement rule changes.

compatibility.detail: API and readiness formats are unchanged. Successful starts add one structured stderr line captured by the service journal.

downtime.detail: No additional migration downtime. Logging measures existing initialization boundaries without changing startup order or readiness.

manual.detail: No profiling configuration is required. The monotonic total starts at daemon initialization entry, not process execution; starts that fail before listener readiness have no summary.

recovery.detail: No recovery action is required; prior versions can open the same store.
